effort: none: goose's generic effort setting, GOOSE_THINKING_EFFORT, is silently dropped for a model without thinking (aaif-goose/goose v1.60.2, crates/goose-providers/src/ollama.rs reasoning_effort)
login: goose's own login: `goose configure` saves the provider and model in ~/.config/goose/config.yaml and the provider key in the system keyring (or ~/.config/goose/secrets.yaml without one)
daemon: goose's developer shell: a command the agent backgrounds keeps running after its shell exits, in that shell's own process group with its output on goose's pipes; stop ends it on Linux, where the supervisor adopts it as subreaper. Linux only
